author: ETA PRIME
description:
ROG teamed up with Hideo Kojima and legendary art director Yoji Shinkawa to create the limited edition ROG Flow Z13 Kojima Productions Edition—and it genuinely feels like a piece of hardware pulled straight out of a cutscene. But this isn’t just about the design. Inside the custom chassis you’re getting the AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395 (Zen 5, 16C/32T) paired with Radeon 8060 graphics (RDNA 3.5, 40 CUs) and a massive 128GB of unified memory. I also show you Armoury Crate tweaks (including iGPU memory allocation), run CPU/GPU benchmarks, then jump into real-world 2560x1600 / 1440p gaming with Death Stranding, Cyberpunk 2077, Forza Horizon 5, Mortal Kombat 1, and Borderlands 4.
If you want me to test more games, AI workloads, or even SteamOS on this thing, let me know in the comments.
